scope: Guard-owned resource evidence for check/run/browser invocations; no extension behavior or product test verdict changed
root_cause: The resource guard emitted admission, watch, unsafe, stop and refusal events only to terminal stdout. Browser UI work could outlive or lose terminal capture, so a useful native observation had no durable resource verdict. The existing evidence recorder reads an already captured guard log and cannot recover missing terminal output.
change: The guard opens a private, exclusive repo-local JSONL journal before policy and command admission; synchronously writes only bounded guard fields on every emit; refuses run-ID reuse; and writes a final resourceInvalid/exitCode/decision event after cleanup. Child stdout is never journaled. If journaling fails while a permit is held, stderr requires browser work to stop, the wrapper exits nonzero, and the lease remains held for the existing recovery procedure.

verification.lightweight_test: node --test scripts/test-stabilization-resource-journal.mjs: 2/2 pass, run outside guard because it invokes only a denied pre-permit command and writer operations; no heavy child ran

limits: The live probe stopped immediately after admission and therefore did not reach a 15-second watch event. The writer test covers watch-event persistence, but a live watch and mid-run disk I/O failure were not induced. This change cannot reconstruct the lost guard evidence from showcase-structured-native-20260928 or convert that run to verified. No product tests, browser UI actions or extension rebuild were performed.
